name: Destiny
description: Bungie's shared-world shooter launched, spawning a decade of Guardians grinding for loot.

name: Mario Kart 8
description: Anti-gravity racing hit the Wii U and instantly became the go-to couch multiplayer game.

name: Dragon Age: Inquisition
description: BioWare's sprawling RPG took home Game of the Year.

name: Far Cry 4
description: Ubisoft sent players to the fictional Himalayan region of Kyrat.

name: Middle-earth: Shadow of Mordor
description: Introduced the Nemesis System, letting orcs remember and hold grudges against you.

name: Dark Souls II
description: FromSoftware kept the notoriously punishing series going.

name: Titanfall
description: Wall-running, mech-piloting shooter that helped launch the Xbox One era.

name: Watch Dogs
description: Ubisoft's hacker-thriller open world set in Chicago.

name: Alien: Isolation
description: A survival horror game that made one relentless Xenomorph genuinely terrifying.

name: Hearthstone
description: Blizzard's card game officially launched out of beta.

name: The Sims 4
description: EA's life simulator got a from-the-ground-up sequel.

name: Bayonetta 2
description: Platinum Games' stylish witch returned, exclusively on Wii U.

name: Wolfenstein: The New Order
description: MachineGames rebooted the classic Nazi-fighting shooter for a new generation.

name: PlayStation 4
description: Released in late 2013, but 2014 was its breakout year.

name: Xbox One
description: Also released late 2013, in full swing throughout 2014.

name: Wii U
description: Nintendo's flagship console before the Switch existed. No Switch. No Steam Deck. No PS5.

name: Guardians of the Galaxy
description: Marvel bet on a talking raccoon and a walking tree, and it paid off big.

name: Interstellar
description: Christopher Nolan sent Matthew McConaughey through a wormhole.

name: The Lego Movie
description: Everything was awesome, including the box office.

name: Captain America: Winter Soldier
description: The MCU movie that turned Cap into a paranoid political thriller hero.

name: Edge of Tomorrow
description: Tom Cruise lived, died, and repeated his way through an alien invasion.

name: John Wick
description: A man, a dog, a car, and a franchise were born.

name: Big Hero 6
description: Disney introduced the world to Baymax.

name: How to Train Your Dragon 2
description: Hiccup and Toothless returned for a bigger, higher-flying sequel.

name: Amazon Echo announced
description: Alexa begins. Nobody knew yet how many kitchens she'd end up in.

name: Apple Pay launched
description: Tap-to-pay started making wallets feel optional.

name: iPhone 6
description: Apple finally went bigger with the screen.

name: iPhone 6 Plus
description: Bigger still, and the start of the phablet era.

name: Android Lollipop
description: Google introduced Material Design to the world.

name: Windows Phone
description: Still out there, still trying to compete.
